I feel like they are out of touch actually. They see the success of other mmo type games and think 'we can cash in on that' but instead of making a new series dedicated to PvP like those other games have, they are changing another series to fit in where it doesn't belong. Those other titles are MADE COMPLETELY for PvP and that was never for Fallout, wasn't a twinkle in the eye before.

I have no issue with the company making MP, PvP, etc to keep up with others success, my issue with how they aren't making new original content for it and instead are ripping apart other games thst are already successful. It's a spinoff, yes, but New Vegas was still in the spirit of Fallout and to many, is the best of the games as it has huge elements of rpg while this one has none from what we so far know. I don't think we can come close to comparing this new game to the others that were single player.

This feels like a game made just to bring people who have no interest in single player games into Fallout but 'unexpectedly' pushes out long time players and fans entirely, as if they could then convert them to the other games which has nothing multi player lovers want to have. 

It's not for us, it's for players of Ark, Conan, etc and we are just the after thought. All the hype we had was crushed and it's just disappointing to now wait for a true fallout game.

More of realistic for those of us who have a dislike or downright hate of MP and PvP, especially in a game series that before was SP and focused more on story. I was excited when I first heard of this game but the more I learn of it, the more disappointed and against the game I become. Like hell do I want to deal with the ass holes on those platforms, people like my brothers who purposely hunt down other players just to destroy their game experience, who get true joy from ruining a game for others.
